description: JFR memory profile: top allocators by bytes/count, allocation stacks, OldObjectSample by class (allocation site, not GC roots). Pair with heap_live_histogram_diff, gc_efficiency, heap_dump+MAT. Requires profile preset recording.

filepath.description: Path to .jfr file. Shortcuts: 'new_profile' (current, default) or 'old_profile' (previous). Or full path e.g. recordings/new_profile.jfr.

sortBy.description: Primary ranking for topAllocators. Default: bytes.

topN.description: Maximum number of top allocators to return. Default: 10.

name: profile_memory
